page.overview:
Who is Bill Steingarten?

Steingarten was the CEO of the biotech company Biosyn in 1989.

When Dodgson planned on stealing dinosaur embryos from InGen, Steingarten was adamant to arrange a board meeting with 11 directors to get approval.

During 1995, Biosyn's head is Jeff Rossiter. It's unknown why Steingarten was replaced.
